saref.blocker: No agent class. SAREF Core has no Actor, Person or Organisation, and no ownership property.

saref_ext.blocker: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor. No ownership property either.

saref.blocker: No agent class and no market-transaction class.

saref_ext.blocker: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor. No market-transaction class.

seas.blocker: seas:Selling/Trading/Transaction exist as classes but carry no properties: nothing links a transaction to its seller, its volume, its time or a confirmation status.

saref.blocker: No agent class, no role model, no region or location term in Core.

saref_ext.blocker: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor. No region term.

seas.blocker: seas:Role/hasRole and seas:Operator/Aggregator/EndUser give the market role, but no property associates an Actor with a region or zone (seas:location is a PropertyKey on FeatureOfInterest; seas:Actor is an AbstractEntity).

saref.blocker: No agent class, no group or community class, no trust relation.

saref_ext.blocker: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor. No community class and no trust relation.

seas.blocker: No community or group class and no membership property for actors; seas:GroupManager exists but the group it manages does not. No trust relation.

saref.blocker: No agent or aggregator class.

saref_ext.blocker: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor. No aggregator class.

seas.blocker: seas:Aggregator exists, but SEAS declares no compliance, trust or prequalification properties, so participation requirements cannot be tested.

saref.blocker: Controllability is expressible (saref:Actuator/Function/Command). Missing: a siting term for node N (saref4bldg:BuildingSpace is an extension) and any response-time property (s4ener territory).

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:hasActivationDelay (xsd:duration, no declared domain) supplies the response-time constraint Core lacked. Still missing: a grid-node term -- s4bldg adds Building and BuildingSpace, which are spatial containers, not network nodes.

seas.blocker: Siting is expressible via seas:ConnectionPoint/Zone. Missing: any response-time property, and a device-level controllability flag (seas:ControlActivity describes the act, not the capability).

saref.blocker: No agent class or ownership property, and no storage-capability term in Core.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:Storage and the RoleType individual EnergyStorage supply the storage capability Core lacked; availability comes from saref:hasState. Still missing: Neither extension adds an agent class. s4ener:Role is a DEVICE role codelist (EnergyConsumer / EnergyProducer / EnergyStorage) and s4ener:hasRole has domain saref:Device, so it cannot carry an actor.

seas.blocker: seas:owns plus seas:Battery/EnergyStorage give the storage-capable assets of an actor. Missing: availability -- the seas operating codelist carries ratings (op-Nominal, op-Min, op-Maximum-*), not an available/unavailable state.

saref.blocker: saref:CommandExecution with saref:hasTimestamp supplies the denominator. Missing: any outcome or status property on an execution, so failures cannot be counted.

seas.blocker: seas:Failure and seas:failure can mark a failed feature of interest. Missing: an activation-attempt event class, so the denominator of a failure ratio has no term.

saref.blocker: No building class in SAREF Core (saref4bldg:Building is an extension) and no heat-pump or battery device kinds in Core (s4ener/s4bldg).

saref_ext.blocker: s4bldg:Building, s4bldg:contains and s4bldg:ElectricFlowStorageDevice make the building and the battery exact. Still missing: a heat-pump class -- NEITHER extension declares one (zero occurrences in both files); the nearest, s4bldg:EnergyConversionDevice, is far broader and also subsumes s4bldg:SolarDevice.
saref_ext.constraint_not_enforced: Rows match, but s4bldg:EnergyConversionDevice is broader than a heat pump and also subsumes s4bldg:SolarDevice.

saref.blocker: saref:Service exists but there is no siting term and no committed-capacity property.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:PowerLimit, PowerEnvelope and FlexOffer express a committed capacity, which Core could not. Still missing: a grid-node siting term and a service-activity status.

seas.blocker: Committed capacity is expressible as a seas:Evaluation interpreted through the flexibility codelist. Missing: a service activity status and any service-to-node siting property.

saref.blocker: No model of a commitment against which delivery is measured.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener power profiles express a commitment and Core observations express the measured value. Still missing: a delivery-event class binding a commitment to its measured outcome so the pair can be compared per event.

seas.blocker: Committed and measured values are both expressible as evaluations. Missing: a delivery-event class binding the pair so the two can be compared per event.

saref.blocker: No contract class.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:ContractualPowerLimit is a power limit, not a contract. No contract class, no end date, no governed-service relation.

seas.blocker: seas:Contract exists and seas:player links it to an actor. Missing: a contract end-date property and any contract-governs-service relation.

saref.blocker: No contract class, no trade class, no penalty term.

saref_ext.blocker: No contract class and no trade class, so no path from a trade to a penalty rate. s4ener has no penalty term.

seas.blocker: seas:Contract exists. Missing: a trade-to-contract association and any penalty-rate property.

seas.blocker: No trade class carrying its parties, no community class, no trust relation.

seas.blocker: No trade class carrying its parties, no community class, no consent term.

saref.blocker: No trade class and no delivery window.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:FlexOffer/FlexRequest describe offers, not concluded trades with a status and a delivery window.

seas.blocker: seas:Transaction has no status property and there is no delivery-window term.

saref.blocker: No trade class and no market clearing window.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:FlexOffer/FlexRequest with hasEnergy and Slot timing express traded energy per slot. Still missing: a market-clearing-window class and any trade-to-window link.

seas.blocker: seas:Transaction, seas:Clearing and seas:Market give the market frame. Missing: a traded-volume property and any window-to-transaction link.

saref.blocker: No agent class; saref:Profile carries a price via profileHasPrice but no tariff structure.

seas.blocker: seas:Price/PricePerEnergy/BasePrice and seas:Profile express a tariff price. Missing: flat-versus-dynamic structural flags, and an actor-level consumption property (nominalEnergyConsumption is on systems).

saref.blocker: No tariff-structure flags, so there is nothing that can contradict.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:IncentiveTableProfile, IncentiveTableTier and IncentiveType give real tariff structure, which Core lacked entirely. Still missing: flat-versus-dynamic flags, so there is still nothing that can contradict.

seas.blocker: No tariff-structure flags, so there is nothing that can contradict.

saref.blocker: No forecast class, no node, no DER-capacity property.

saref_ext.blocker: s4ener:hasDemandRateForecast and hasUsageForecast supply the forecast Core lacked. Still missing: a grid-node term and any DER-capacity property.

seas.blocker: seas:NetworkNode/ElectricPowerSystem give the node and SEAS has forecasting classes. Missing: forecasting is weather-specific (WeatherForecast, WeatherForecasting) with no load-forecast value bound to a node, and no DER-capacity property.

seas.blocker: SEAS is the only one of the three with the activity taxonomy (seas:Activity, ForecastingActivity, PlanningActivity, OptimizationActivity).
